description: Data + catalogue + migration substrate for Phase 2. Adds the students.* permission + role bindings + students.view_own and the eight students.student.* audit keys to @campusgate/shared, the SIS zod schemas, the three new enums + two new tenant-owned Prisma models (StudentProfileHistory, StudentDocument) + the additive-nullable generalization of the LIVE StudentProfile (status enum defaulted ACTIVE, admissionDate, programId/academicSessionId/currentTermId composite links, back-relations), the ONE new hand-authored phase2_sis migration (enums, additive ALTERs, CREATE TABLEs, composite same-tenant FKs incl. institutionId, RLS ENABLE+FORCE fail-closed with the append-only pair/trigger/REVOKE on history + standard pair on documents, campass_app GRANT refresh, catalogue seed with exact sync markers) applied to live Supabase via the checksum-drift workaround (seven FROZEN migrations untouched), the Prisma client regenerate, and the demo-seed extension. This is the foundation FEAT-002 (API) and FEAT-003 (tests) build on; it must leave shared dist current, the Prisma client regenerated, and the DB migrated with eight migrations. Depends on nothing else in this task. Independent of FEAT-002/003 only in that they strictly follow it (they consume its schema/catalogue).
steps: Read c:/campusgate/.agents/tasks/phase2-sis/context.json and this file FIRST, then design.md sections 3,4,5.6,7.4,7.5,10,12 and the newest reference migration packages/db/prisma/migrations/20261027111710_phase1_academics/migration.sql (the append-only academic_calendar_day_revisions pair + the programs/academic_terms composite FKs are the exact templates). Also read .agents/tasks/phase1-academics/features/FEAT-001.json for the proven migration/checksum-drift/catalogue-sync conventions.

Generalize StudentProfile (ALL existing fields UNCHANGED): add status StudentStatus @default(ACTIVE), admissionDate DateTime?, programId String? + structuredProgram Program? @relation(fields:[programId],references:[id]) (name MUST be structuredProgram, not program — the scalar program column stays), academicSessionId String? + academicSession AcademicSession? @relation(...), currentTermId String? + currentTerm AcademicTerm? @relation(...), history StudentProfileHistory[], documents StudentDocument[]; add @@index([institutionId, status]) and @@index([institutionId, programId]) (keep the existing @@unique([id,institutionId]), @@index([institutionId]), @@map). Add models StudentProfileHistory (design §4.1: institutionId + institution relation; studentProfileId + studentProfile relation; changeType; previous*/new* snapshot columns for status/programId/programText/semester/departmentId/sessionId/termId; actorUserId, actorMembershipId?, reason?, metadata Json?; createdAt; @@unique([id,institutionId]); @@index([institutionId]), @@index([institutionId,studentProfileId]), @@index([studentProfileId]); @@map("student_profile_history")) and StudentDocument (design §5.6: institutionId + relation; studentProfileId + relation; kind @default(OTHER); title; storageKey; contentType?; sizeBytes?; uploadedByUserId; createdAt; updatedAt; @@unique([id,institutionId]); @@index([institutionId]), @@index([institutionId,studentProfileId]); @@map("student_documents")). Do NOT run prisma migrate dev (plain OR --create-only) against shared Supabase. Sections IN ORDER (design §10.1): (a) CREATE TYPE the three enums; (b) ALTER TABLE "student_profiles" ADD COLUMN "status" "StudentStatus" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' (this IS the backfill), ADD COLUMN "admissionDate" TIMESTAMP(3), ADD COLUMN "programId"/"academicSessionId"/"currentTermId" TEXT (nullable); (c) CREATE TABLE student_profile_history + student_documents with PKs, (id,institutionId) uniques, institutionId + composite indexes; (d) tenant-root FKs institutionId->institutions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT on both new tables; (e) composite same-tenant FKs — DROP student_profiles' three single-col Prisma FKs (student_profiles_programId_fkey / _academicSessionId_fkey / _currentTermId_fkey) and ADD student_profiles_program_same_tenant_fkey/_session_same_tenant_fkey/_term_same_tenant_fkey FOREIGN KEY (institutionId,<col>) REFERENCES parent(institutionId,id) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE; plus student_profile_history.studentProfileId and student_documents.studentProfileId composite FKs -> student_profiles(institutionId,id) ON DELETE RESTRICT; (f) CREATE INDEX the two new student_profiles indexes (institutionId,status) + (institutionId,programId); (g) DO $$ ENABLE+FORCE RLS with nullif-guarded fail-closed policies — student_documents the STANDARD pair (tenant_isolation_select FOR SELECT + tenant_isolation_modify FOR ALL WITH CHECK), student_profile_history the APPEND-ONLY pair (tenant_isolation_select FOR SELECT + student_profile_history_tenant_insert FOR INSERT WITH CHECK, NO modify policy); do NOT touch student_profiles RLS; (h) function student_profile_history_append_only() raising restrict_violation + trigger student_profile_history_no_update_delete BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE binding every role; (i) guarded DO $$ IF EXISTS(pg_roles ... 'campass_app') GRANT SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE ON "student_documents" + GRANT SELECT,INSERT ON "student_profile_history" and REVOKE UPDATE,DELETE from campass_app on it (never BYPASSRLS); (j) seed the six students.* permissions + students.view_own into "permissions" and their (roleKey,permKey) pairs into "role_permissions" with the EXACT catalogue-sync markers (INSERT INTO "permissions" ... ON CONFLICT ; INSERT INTO "role_permissions" ... SELECT ... FROM (VALUES ...) AS m(...)), idempotent ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, byte-for-byte the phase1_academics shape. No separate backfill UPDATE; no structured-link backfill in DDL. Do NOT edit any FROZEN migration.

Confirm + apply: run npx prisma migrate diff --from-url "$DIRECT_URL" --to-schema-datamodel packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma --script (read-only) and compare its student_profiles ALTERs/CREATE TABLEs/FK/index output against the hand-authored SQL (diff does NOT model RLS/trigger/grant/seed — review by eye vs phase1_academics). findings:
DONE & VERIFIED. New migration dir: 20261027161616_phase2_sis (timestamp from system clock, UTC; sorts AFTER the seven FROZEN dirs). Applied to live Supabase via `prisma migrate deploy` (exit 0, 'All migrations have been successfully applied'); `prisma migrate status` (from packages/db) reports 8 migrations, 'Database schema is up to date!'. The seven FROZEN dirs are byte-for-byte unchanged (git status shows only the new untracked 20261027161616_phase2_sis/ dir under migrations/; git diff --stat over tracked migrations is empty). campass_app stays NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS (no BYPASSRLS granted anywhere).

DEVIATION 1 (the one real authoring correction, and the reason for an initial failed-then-recovered deploy): the literal step-8(e) instruction said to DROP student_profiles' three single-col Prisma FKs (student_profiles_programId_fkey / _academicSessionId_fkey / _currentTermId_fkey) then ADD the composites. That DROP pattern is correct ONLY when the generalized columns already exist with Prisma-generated single-col FKs (the Phase-1 case, where academic_calendar_days columns pre-existed). In Phase 2 the three link columns are BRAND-NEW columns added by this same migration's section (b); Postgres does NOT auto-create a FK on ADD COLUMN, so those single-col constraints never existed. My first `migrate deploy` therefore failed at step 0 with 42704 'constraint student_profiles_programId_fkey ... does not exist' and Postgres rolled the WHOLE migration transaction back (verified: applied_steps_count=0 and a live privileged-client probe confirmed NONE of the enums/columns/tables/FKs/trigger/permissions existed — the DB was byte-for-byte pre-migration, only a failed _prisma_migrations ledger row remained). Recovery per docs/database.md (NEVER a reset, NEVER a manual checksum edit): (1) removed the three non-existent-constraint DROP statements from section (e) so it ADDs the composite FKs directly; (2) `prisma migrate resolve --rolled-back 20261027161616_phase2_sis` to clear the failed ledger row; (3) re-ran `migrate deploy` -> success. The pre-existing harmless superadmin_security checksum drift did NOT interfere (migrate deploy does not re-verify applied-migration checksums, as Phase 1 proved). Retried P1001 'Can't reach database server' transient pooler errors (free tier pauses on inactivity) on deploy + status + the verification probe — all succeeded on retry. (NOTE for FEAT-002/003: the ledger now carries BOTH a rolled_back row and the successful applied row for 20261027161616_phase2_sis; this is the normal Prisma resolve pattern and `migrate status` is green — do not be alarmed by the two rows.)

DEVIATION 2 (cosmetic): seed history snapshot. The one seeded ENROLLED StudentProfileHistory row per demo student sets newStatus/newProgramId/newProgramText/newSemester/newDepartmentId/newSessionId/newTermId (the post-enroll snapshot) with actorUserId = the demo admin user id and a reason string; previous* left null (there is no prior state at seed time). Matches §12 intent (one ENROLLED row, findFirst-guarded create, never upsert).

FINAL MODEL/TABLE NAMES: StudentProfileHistory -> student_profile_history (append-only); StudentDocument -> student_documents (standard pair).

STUDENTPROFILE NEW FIELDS (all additive-nullable/defaulted; existing fields UNCHANGED, program:String + semester:Int RETAINED): status StudentStatus @default(ACTIVE); admissionDate DateTime?; programId String? + structuredProgram Program? @relation([programId]) (relation field is structuredProgram, NOT program — the scalar free-text program column stays); academicSessionId String? + academicSession AcademicSession?; currentTermId String? + currentTerm AcademicTerm?; history StudentProfileHistory[]; documents StudentDocument[]. New indexes: @@index([institutionId,status]) + @@index([institutionId,programId]) (existing @@unique([id,institutionId]) + @@index([institutionId]) + @@map kept).

STUDENTPROFILEHISTORY fields (snapshot columns, design §4.1): institutionId(+institution rel), studentProfileId(+studentProfile rel), changeType StudentHistoryChangeType, previousStatus/newStatus, previousProgramId/newProgramId, previousProgramText/newProgramText, previousSemester/newSemester, previousDepartmentId/newDepartmentId, previousSessionId/newSessionId, previousTermId/newTermId, actorUserId, actorMembershipId?, reason?, metadata Json? (stored JSONB), createdAt. @@unique([id,institutionId]); @@index([institutionId]),([institutionId,studentProfileId]),([studentProfileId]).
STUDENTDOCUMENT fields (design §5.6): institutionId(+rel), studentProfileId(+rel), kind StudentDocumentKind @default(OTHER), title, storageKey, contentType?, sizeBytes?, uploadedByUserId, createdAt, updatedAt. @@unique([id,institutionId]); @@index([institutionId]),([institutionId,studentProfileId]).

MIGRATION FK/RLS/TRIGGER/GRANT SHAPE (verified live): tenant-root FKs institutionId->institutions(id) RESTRICT on both new tables. Composite same-tenant FKs (incl. institutionId): student_profiles_program_same_tenant_fkey (institutionId,programId)->programs(institutionId,id) SET NULL; student_profiles_session_same_tenant_fkey ->academic_sessions SET NULL; student_profiles_term_same_tenant_fkey ->academic_terms SET NULL; student_profile_history_student_same_tenant_fkey (institutionId,studentProfileId)->student_profiles(institutionId,id) RESTRICT; student_documents_student_same_tenant_fkey ->student_profiles RESTRICT. student_profiles RLS NOT touched (keeps FROZEN B-1 ENABLE+FORCE + standard pair + grant). NEW RLS: student_documents = STANDARD pair {tenant_isolation_select FOR SELECT, tenant_isolation_modify FOR ALL WITH CHECK}; student_profile_history = APPEND-ONLY pair {tenant_isolation_select FOR SELECT, student_profile_history_tenant_insert FOR INSERT WITH CHECK}, NO modify policy, all nullif(current_setting('app.current_institution_id',true),'')-guarded. Trigger: function student_profile_history_append_only() raises restrict_violation; trigger student_profile_history_no_update_delete BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE (binds every role).

campass_app GRANT/REVOKE shape (guarded DO $$ IF EXISTS pg_roles 'campass_app'): GRANT SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE ON student_documents; GRANT SELECT,INSERT ON student_profile_history + REVOKE UPDATE,DELETE ON student_profile_history FROM campass_app. No grant on student_profiles (inherits B-1 table grant + ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES). Never BYPASSRLS.
